testcase.name: partners get their portals, not staff screens
owner work never starts a backend mobile session (P1-A3b)
codeOnly strips comments and nothing else
owner-only decisions are offered to the owner only
owner work uses a separate Firebase app and never the personal sign-in (P1-A3b)
module ids are unique and every link resolves
every write is behind a confirmation
every API route a screen calls exists on the backend
the observer is offered reads only
a member without a permission is not offered its action
owner two-step sign-in is offered to owners only, and verify is a route ApiClient adopts (P1-A3)
app permission names are the server's
ticket screens write through the API, never Firestore (P1-D)
a partner session only ever calls routes on the partner allowlist
